title: Overall accuracy
headline: Company weekly revenue forecasts were 97.3% accurate over 24 tested weeks, with absolute misses 81.0% smaller than last year's pattern ($578.3k total absolute miss vs $3.04m).
source_numbers: accuracy 97.3%; baseline improvement 81.0%; abs miss $578,334.28; baseline abs miss $3,037,925.33

title: Strongest and weakest areas
headline: California is the most accurate state (97.4%) and Wisconsin the least (96.0%); by store, CA_1 is strongest (97.5%) and CA_2 weakest (93.5%).

title: Latest 4 weeks reliability
headline: Company accuracy stays between 96.7% and 97.7% from 1 to 4 weeks ahead. In the latest tested 4 weeks (2016-04-23 to 2016-05-14) the forecast was $3.72m against $3.88m actual (4.1% below), inside the likely range in 1 of 4 weeks. No future weeks are forecast.
source_numbers: 1 week ahead 97.7%; 2 weeks ahead 96.7%; 3 weeks ahead 97.2%; 4 weeks ahead 97.7%

title: What to do
headline: Plan with company and state forecasts (97.3% accurate). Hold a wider buffer at CA_2 and WI_2, the 2 stores below the chosen 95% accuracy cut-off.
